svg.title: One chatbot turn
svg.desc: A local model sorts the question first; every intent except in-scope gets a fixed reply without the chatbot model, and a question the classifier can't sort goes on to the model. Otherwise the model calls tools in a loop of at most eight calls; its answer then passes an empty-answer check, a check of the whole draft before it is returned (quote marks around words no search returned count as unretrieved evidence; a figure or a reading such as slightly positive that no tool returned is also caught); a draft that fails is written again once with the problem named, then trimmed of the sentences that state it, and withheld if too little is left, so no warning is ever shown; the citations it retrieved are numbered with their sources listed, before it is shown.
